purpose: Mechanism overview in expanded report page 15
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational / infographic-diagram. Create one publication-quality raster mechanism illustration for a Chinese technical competition report about Kylin Memory Bench. Use GPT Image 2 if available. Wide 3:2 composition, pure white background, fine consistent charcoal strokes, muted teal, scientific blue and restrained coral, elegant technical typography, lots of whitespace, absolutely no gradients, mascots, school logos, medals, decorative science-fiction effects, or fabricated performance plots. Large, exceptionally legible short Chinese labels.
Title: 可验证的长期记忆评测
Three clearly separated left-to-right vertical lanes with headings: ① 配对式增量任务, ② 四路证据判定, ③ 重复可靠性.
Lane1: split a common task into two matched branches labeled 提供相关资料 and 替换为无关资料. Both branches lead to the same stages 写入 → 干扰 → 新会话任务, then converge on a box 目标达成差值. Draw separate tiny isolated workspace outlines for the two branches. Their task request is identical. A small footer label 查询与行动相同. Do not imply disabling the agent memory backend.
Lane2: four short-labeled evidence documents 回复, 长期记录, 工具轨迹, 实际文件 converge into a diamond 证据完整？. The complete branch goes to 结构化断言, then two results 通过 and 失败. The incomplete branch goes separately to 不可评分. A separate box 冻结真值 has an arrow ONLY into 结构化断言, never into the agent or task input. Keep arrows readable and unambiguous.
Lane3: three trial rows labeled 第1轮, 第2轮, 第3轮 feed into two distinct boxes 持续成功 and 状态一致, then into 可重算报告. Use neutral document/repeat symbols only, not numeric scores or invented pass rates. A small footer label 同输入・同配置・独立会话.
Overall meaning: paired source availability, evidence-grounded deterministic scoring, and repeated system reliability are complementary. This is a mechanism illustration, not experimental evidence. Do not include any accuracy, F1, latency, benchmark scores, or claims of world-first status. Keep all key labels exactly as written and proofread Chinese.
review: Chinese labels and three decision lanes visually checked; arrows distinguish matched source conditions, evidence gating and repeated reliability. No experimental values in image.
caption: GPT image-tool mechanism illustration based on implemented protocol; not experimental evidence.
